title: Round 7 stream C: SOL-82's second seat at once, the Ridgebacks as batteries, the mech's print a beat of THE ARENA's SECURE
context: Owner, 2026-11-05, nine notes on b14ed61f (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-05-round-7-nine-notes-design.md, stream C): 5) the second commandeering of SOL should be almost immediate once announced, Isao's later comms happening while we control the satellite; 7) the mechs at THE MOTHER's site should be more aggressive and shoot more often; 8) before BELOW, Isao prints something but we have no time to see it. Branch round-7-arena off 21eee83a, port 18183, unpushed.
outcome: NOTE 5: THE CANYON AGAIN lays its pass and seats the player CANYON.again.seatDelay (2 s) after its announce, the column still rising (src/domain/canyon.js canyonSeatDue, tested; the first canyon keeps 'column up, then seatAfter'); that pass stays overhead CANYON.again.overhead 60 s; canyon_pass is said over the seat once Isao's panel is free (the queue is one deep: at 2 s it would have been dropped behind the sector's line and canyon_again); Isao's card, hidden in SOL-82's seat before, stands top right of it (app.css; the phone keeps its seat bare). Measured headless on --canyon-again: base, the seat 3.03 s after canyon_again was shown and about 12.4 s after the sector's line (the column released at 24.2 and up at 27.2 on the sector clock, the seat at 29.4); now the seat 1.90 s after the announce, the column up 8.35 s after the seat, the sector line, canyon_again and canyon_pass all said while seated. Overhead 60 = the first canyon's 45 over a risen column plus that rise and a margin for a slow machine's crowd gate. NOTE 7: REINFORCEMENTS.fire { cadence 1.8, range 1.35, bossShare 0.15 } on the mechs' records only (src/domain/mech-roles.js batteryDef: the record's def is its sentry's, faster and farther; a Quiver's reach stays its missile's; a Rotor's barrels heat 1/cadence a round so a battery never locks), and the arena pair walks to the ring REINFORCEMENTS.engageCells (6) +-1 hops round the mother while her body leads her record (nextCell's quarry, tested), back to its plain at her death. Measured on --arena-fight NOFIRE=1 (the gunship silent, 150 s): the arena pair 458 and 306 shots a minute on the base (382 a mech), 1,233 and 1,097 now (3.0x); the base mech 168 -> 402, the hunter 653 -> 1,111; frames with a weapon on a target 0.996-1.0 before and after (the swarm is always in reach, so the gain is the cadence and the reach); the pair's mean arc to her 6.1/7.7 -> 5.4/6.3 cells (they walk 0.08 cells/s, she 10-25 m/s, so closing moves them little). Her death with the gunship silent: base not in 133 s on the ground (6.7 hp left, ~138 s projected), bossShare 0.2 63.8 s after landing, 0.15 79 s. With the gunship firing (the step's own run) the fight is 34-40 s now against 52-92 s on two base runs, decided by its two MK-9s (about 70 hp each); in those runs the four land 17 s into the window and their Rotors barely fire (the 40 mm's scares keep the bodies out of reach), the Quivers do. NOTE 8: after THE ARENA's securePause, Isao's lines over the mother and bossEnd, sector-run asks api.printNow('mech', then) (src/fx/pet-print.js): the mech's print runs forced, its close-up and pet_print_mech as ever, the sector in phase 'print' (game live), and `then` shows the debrief when it ends or is skipped; a running cut still holds it, COMPANIONS.print.nowWait 35 s at most (12 was first written: past it the drop's 28 s cut would have lost the print to the fallback), then the debrief goes without it and the round-6 trigger stays the fallback. descent-host begin waits in phase 'print' while a print runs (DESCENT.printCap 45 game s), then says its brief. Measured on ?skip=defence&sector=8&boss=1 (--pet-print, PET_ARENA=1 runs only that beat): SECURE -> the arena's end 16.4 s (securePause 3 + Isao's lines over the mother), then the FEIDS-26 drop's cut, held by the seat through the fight, takes the camera as the seat is left and holds the print 7.4 s; the print then runs its whole 27.6 s and the debrief opens the frame it ends, never during it. On --arena-carcass the print began 0.02 s after the arena's end. td-tab 5,349 lines, bytes 322,386 -> 322,346 (wireCount moved to src/fx/model-fixture.js, one copy with companions'). DESIGN DECISIONS OVERTURNED: bossShare 0.15 not 0.2 (the design's own rule: at 0.2 the four alone took her in 63.8 s, too close to 60); engageCells 6 not 8 (8 is outside the Rotor's 7.2-cell battery reach); the cadence and range applied where the record is made (its def), not in tower-combat's effectiveStats read, so tower-aim and the spin read the same reach; 'shots at least doubled' asserted on the NOFIRE run, not on the fired one (there the four are on the ground 17-23 s); 'the print within securePause + 2 s of SECURE' became 'within 2 s of the arena's end, or as a running cut ends' (Isao's lines over the mother, an earlier owner note, come first); the canyon_pass line waits for a free panel instead of being shown at the seat, and Isao's card is moved into SOL's seat rather than copied onto the seat's strip.
alternatives: Show canyon_pass at the seat as before: rejected, the one-deep queue drops it behind the sector's line and canyon_again 2 s after the announce.
Copy Isao's line onto SOL-82's seat strip: rejected for showing his own card top right in the seat (one panel, the voice and the dwell unchanged).
Keep bossShare 0.2 (the design's number): rejected, 63.8 s alone is inside the rule's margin; 0.15 gives 79 s.
A faster walk for the closing pair: not done, the heavy gait (0.08 cells/s) is the owner's 2026-10-23 note; closing moves the pair about a cell nearer on average.
Let the FEIDS-26 drop wait for a pending print: not done (out of this stream's files); the print waits for the drop's cut instead, nowWait covering it.
